mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown or recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and economic growth slow.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market and consumer spending that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer spending that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS grows > 5% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by less than 100,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 100k for 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals high inflation that will erode consumer purchasing power and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
